content: संनिपत् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To alight, descend. .²2 To come together, assemble, meet together. .²3 To fall upon, attack; उद्दामेन द्विरदपतिना संनिपत्याभियुक्तः <ls>U. 3. 6</ls>. .²4 To arrive, appear. .²5 To perish, be destroyed. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To throw or shoot down, discharge. .²2 To convoke, convene, assemble, collect together. .²3 To stretch out (a cord).
